northstar.title: Northstar Relay — WorldFixture
northstar.description: Synthetic people, projects, finance, support, software, and communication from WorldFixture business.saas-company:v3. Fixed snapshot; source dates extend to 2027. Money is stored in integer cents with its currency. Timeline events are not applied.

open_work.title: Open work, and who has it
open_work.sql:
select projects.name as project, tasks.title, tasks.status, tasks.priority, people.name as assignee, tasks.due_on
from tasks
join projects on projects.id = tasks.project_id
left
join people on people.id = tasks.assignee_id
where tasks.status != 'done'
order by case tasks.priority when 'urgent' then 0 when 'high' then 1 else 2 end, tasks.due_on

time_logged.title: Time logged, by person
time_logged.sql:
select time_entries.date, people.name as person, tasks.title as task, time_entries.minutes, time_entries.note
from time_entries
join people on people.id = time_entries.person_id
join tasks on tasks.id = time_entries.task_id
order by time_entries.date desc, people.name

money_owed.title: Invoices that are still open
money_owed.sql:
select invoices.number, customers.name as customer, invoices.description, invoices.issued_on, invoices.due_on, invoices.amount_cents, invoices.currency, invoices.status
from invoices
join customers on customers.id = invoices.customer_id
where invoices.status != 'paid'
order by invoices.due_on

monthly_books.title: Invoices and supplier bills by month and currency
monthly_books.sql:
select substr(issued_on, 1, 7) as month, currency, sum(invoiced_cents) as invoiced_cents, sum(supplier_cost_cents) as supplier_cost_cents
from (select issued_on, currency, amount_cents as invoiced_cents, 0 as supplier_cost_cents
from invoices
union all select issued_on, currency, 0, amount_cents
from supplier_bills)
group by 1, 2
order by 1 desc, 2

support_queue.title: Support cases and their owners
support_queue.sql:
select support_cases.title, customers.name as customer, people.name as owner, support_cases.state, support_cases.priority, support_cases.next_action
from support_cases
join customers on customers.id = support_cases.customer_id
left
join people on people.id = support_cases.owner_id
order by support_cases.opened_at desc

recent_messages.title: Recent team messages
recent_messages.sql:
select chat_messages.timestamp, channels.name as channel, people.name as author, chat_messages.text
from chat_messages
join channels on channels.id = chat_messages.channel_id
join people on people.id = chat_messages.author_id
order by chat_messages.timestamp desc
limit 100
